description: The Hyleg (Apheta, 'giver of life') and Alcocoden (Kadhkhudah, 'giver of years') system for determining vitality and estimating lifespan.
source: Ptolemy, Tetrabiblos; Vettius Valens, Anthology; Dorotheus of Sidon; Guido Bonatti, Liber Astronomiae

hyleg_selection.description: The Hyleg is the principal life indicator, selected from a strict hierarchy of candidates.
hyleg_selection.five_degree_rule: A planet within 5° before a cusp is counted as being in that house if in the same sign.
requirements: Must be in a hylegical house (1, 7, 9, 10, or 11)
Must be aspected by one of its essential dignity rulers
Must not be significantly afflicted (combust, retrograde with malefic, etc.)

alcocoden_determination.description: The Alcocoden is the planet that rules the Hyleg's position through essential dignity and aspects the Hyleg.
alcocoden_determination.requirement: Must aspect the Hyleg via Ptolemaic aspect (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition)
alcocoden_determination.highest_points_wins: The planet with the highest dignity points becomes the Alcocoden

planetary_years.description: The planetary periods used in lifespan calculation. Angular = Major, Succedent = Mean, Cadent = Minor.

calculation_method.step_1: Determine the Hyleg using the hierarchical selection process
calculation_method.step_2: Identify the Alcocoden as the strongest ruler of the Hyleg's position that aspects the Hyleg
calculation_method.step_3: Select planetary period scale based on Alcocoden's house position (Angular=Major, Succedent=Mean, Cadent=Minor)
calculation_method.step_4: Add benefic aspect contributions (Jupiter/Venus minor years + months of mean years)
calculation_method.step_5: Subtract malefic aspect contributions (Mars/Saturn minor years + months of mean years)
calculation_method.step_6: Apply condition modifiers for weak/retrograde/combust planets
calculation_method.result: Final result represents potential lifespan, not certain death prediction

differentia_system.first_differentia: Strong Hyleg in essential dignity, well-aspected - robust vitality
differentia_system.second_differentia: Moderate Hyleg, mixed aspects - average vitality
differentia_system.third_differentia: No valid Hyleg, or Hyleg severely afflicted - vulnerable vitality

critical_periods.description: Periods when vitality may be challenged based on planetary minor years
critical_periods.interpretation: These ages represent potential health challenges, not certain death

modern_application.focus: Health vulnerability assessment rather than death prediction
modern_application.use: Identifies periods when native should be attentive to health and well-being
modern_application.transits: Challenging aspects to Alcocoden often coincide with health crises
